note: EB3-A change-impact graph (plan U7-2). scripts/eb3-impact.mjs maps each changed path to the CI layers and checks it selects. A changed path selects the UNION of every rule that matches it (not first-match and not most-specific-only: a narrower rule matching is never a reason to drop a broader rule's checks). A changed path matched by NO rule is UNKNOWN impact, and UNKNOWN selects the `unknown` set below, which is the full layered CI: unknown impact may never select zero checks. Layer names are the ids of dev/ci/eb3-ci-manifest.json; an unknown layer name in this file is a refusal (IMPACT_LAYER_UNKNOWN).

always.note: Every change, including an empty one, runs ci-fast with docs:probe. docs:probe is mandatory, not impact-selected.

unknown.note: What an UNKNOWN path selects: everything. A rule that wants less must be written down.

rules.why: prose: document consistency only. A doc hit triggers docs:sync --check.
